1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 c6 5.b3.strategy: Completes the double fianchetto: the bishop looks along the long diagonal at the f6 knight and the e5 square, and White controls the centre with pieces from a distance instead of occupying it with pawns. A slow, manoeuvring game follows, in which neither side has much to attack at first.
